title: The Lord’s word fulfilled
summary: The narrator says those who would not hearken to his words were cut off from the Lord’s presence. He attributes a curse and a change in their skin to the Lord, reports the Lord’s warning about repentance, and says the Lord’s words concerning their seed were fulfilled.

explicit_facts.text: The narrator says the Lord’s word was fulfilled and that those who would not hearken to his words were cut off from the Lord’s presence.
The narrator attributes a curse to their iniquity and hardened hearts, and says the Lord caused a skin of blackness to come upon them so they would not be enticing to his people.
The Lord says they would be loathsome to the narrator’s people unless they repented of their iniquities.
The passage says the seed of one who mixes with their seed would receive the same curse, and that the Lord spoke it and it was done.

unspecified_visual_details: The location, the identities of those described, and any visible process by which they were cut off or changed are unspecified.

narration.text: they were cut off from his presence.

a skin of blackness to come upon them.
And the Lord spake it, and it was done.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These verses present the narrator’s religious explanation and reported description. The comparison to flint is figurative, not a physical transformation.
prohibited_inventions: Do not identify or depict particular individuals not named in these verses.
Do not invent a visible divine figure or a process for the reported change.
Do not present skin color as evidence of character or worth.
